question: In a code language, REFLECT is written as WVKOJXY. How will SECTION be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The pattern follows here is :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6e8de234d9ece96580076ce21cc2fef82fb5ae06c5bed23f0deaabf3e3070e27.png] 

Alternate alphabets are reverse (positional opposite).

Similarly,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47918e1aacefc3beca22556fa34250e94f99dfeb67b57fb2546c1b85e8ea21db.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"XVHGNLS".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Positional opposite (reverse) is that pair of alphabets whose place value sum is 27.
